description: This file defines a utility class 'AuthUtil' that provides a static method to create an HTTP entity with basic authentication headers, used for constructing HTTP requests with authentication details in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: AuthUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for creating HTTP entities with authentication headers.

methods.name: createEntityWithBasicAuth
methods.description: Creates an HttpEntity with the provided body and headers set for content type, accept media type, and basic authentication.
